title: Design System: OfficeLab Repository
scope: html[data-ui-mode="repository"] (light on root, dark under nested .dark); Wiki mode excluded

display.purpose: Home headline only; leading count in accent-text. zh-CN 32px/-0.01em; under 720px 28px (24px zh).

headline.purpose: Page, repository and settings titles; Pull request detail title steps to 28px.

title-sm.purpose: Card titles (15.5px), issue titles (14.5px), chart title.

label.purpose: Sentence-case side-nav group headings in ink-3; chips at 12px.

figure.purpose: Counts, chart axes, ranks, fact numbers, CLI command, kbd hint. Never prose.

shadows.name: inset-ring
shadows.purpose: Layout-neutral outline on tiles, avatars, badges, pressed segments.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus everywhere in the mode.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border transitions on links, rows, buttons, inputs.

motion.name: chart-dim
motion.purpose: Non-hovered or non-picked chart columns fade to 0.28.

motion.name: card-press
motion.purpose: Active state on linked item cards.

surfaces.name: top-bar
surfaces.value: background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--rd-bg) 92%, transparent); backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(10px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rd-line); min-height: 56px

narrative.overview:
This system governs the Workspace Browser's **Repository mode only**: every token and rule lives under `html[data-ui-mode="repository"]` (light on the root, dark under the nested `.dark` class). Wiki mode keeps its own look and is not part of this world. Repository mode keeps GitHub's habits (top bar search, Code / Issues / Pull requests / Pages / Settings tabs, file table, About panel, issue filters) and dresses them in an OpenRouter-style console: a near-white or near-black ground, hairline borders, one saturated accent, and live figures set in a monospace.

A repository introduces itself with identity and numbers before files: name, copyable slug, Private badge and Star, an inline run of metadata (Members, Files, Last updated), the tabs, then a stacked daily activity chart above the file table. Home leads with a counted headline and a ranked bar list of open work per repository. Density is office-work density: 14px body, 50px file rows, 36px controls. Light is the default appearance, because the audience works in daylit offices; dark is the console variant with electric lime.

The system is flat, quiet and precise. Office content stays the hero; chrome is hairlines and fills one step off the ground.
keyCharacteristics: Two themes, one accent slot: violet in light, lime in dark, never both.
Flat at rest; one soft shadow, only for floating layers.
Plus Jakarta Sans for all words; Geist Mono only for figures and identifiers.
Content kinds tinted on small rounded tiles; people shown as circular initials.
Hairline borders at 9% and 16% ink, never solid grey rules.

rules.name: The One Accent Slot Rule
rules.body: Violet belongs to light and lime belongs to dark; they fill the same roles (primary action, current tab or view, pressed toggle, focus ring, selection) and never appear together. The chart's Pull request series and the Board kind follow the accent, so they flip with the theme.

rules.name: The Kind Is a Tint Rule
rules.body: Content-kind colour appears only on the 26px icon tile: the hue as icon colour, 14% as fill, 26% as an inset ring. Rows, names and text never take the kind hue.

rules.name: The Reserved Pair Rule
rules.body: People blue and agents pink are spent on nothing until attribution ships: not on charts, labels, avatars or decoration.

rules.name: The Mark Owns Vermilion Rule
rules.body: Flask Vermilion appears in the OfficeLab mark and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Mono Counts Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for numbers, identifiers and code only. Words, labels and headings are always Plus Jakarta Sans. Inside card metadata runs, numbers return to the sans with tabular figures so a sentence does not change face midway.

rules.name: The Tight Heading Rule
rules.body: Everything 18px and up is 700 or 800 with negative tracking (-0.025em to -0.032em); Chinese eases to -0.01em.

rules.name: The Published Pages Exception
rules.body: The Pages directory renders in a GitHub Pages (Primer) look: system UI stack at 16px with its own page palette (`--rd-page-*`, light and dark). It is scoped to `.repository-pages` and is the only place the system font stack is the face.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Hover changes fill (to panel-2) and border (to line-2), never lift. The only motion on press is a 1px downward nudge on item cards.

rules.name: Tiles for Things, Circles for People
rules.body: Repositories and content kinds sit on rounded-square tiles (24 to 34px, 7 to 10px radius); people are circular initial avatars (20, 24 or 32px). The two shapes never swap.

dos: Do scope every Repository-mode rule under `:root[data-ui-mode="repository"]` and its nested `.dark`; Wiki mode is a separate world.
Do route the primary action, current tab or view, focus ring and selection through the accent slot so it reads violet in light and lime in dark.
Do set counts, axes, ranks, identifiers and commands in Geist Mono with tabular figures.
Do show content kind on a tinted 26px tile (14% fill, 26% inset ring) and people as circular initials.
Do separate inline metadata with 1px line-2 vertical rules.
Do keep in-flow surfaces flat: hover is a fill step to panel-2 and a border step to line-2.
donts: Don't use the people blue or agents pink series colours until the attribution feature ships; they are reserved and currently unused.
Don't show violet in dark or lime in light, or put white text on lime.
Don't add drop shadows to cards, list frames or the chart card; the float shadow is for tooltips, popovers, menus and dialogs only.
Don't set prose, labels or headings in the mono.
Don't use Flask Vermilion outside the OfficeLab mark.
Don't put small uppercase eyebrow labels above headings; group labels are sentence case, 12.5px, ink-3.
Don't colour row text or file names with content-kind hues.
